message.content: Based on the information provided, Helios seems to be interested in various aspects of the games he discusses. Additionally, Helios is curious about the gameplay mechanics, particularly in open-world games like "The Witcher 3," and he enjoys the dynamic nature of these games, noting how the narrative can evolve based on player choices and actions. His interest in the visual storytelling and atmosphere of games such as "Returnal" also indicates a desire to understand how these elements enhance the overall gaming experience. Furthermore, Helios seems eager to learn more about the strategic elements of games, mentioning his enjoyment of games with good tactical gameplay, and he has expressed interest in games like "XCOM 2" and "Fire Emblem." Overall, Helios appears to be a thoughtful gamer who is keen to learn more about the interplay between storytelling, character development, and gameplay mechanics across different titles.
